items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: the Dean of Music at North Texas State came up to New York and took me out to lunch.

ctx.x: Nice and do you get some sizable checks that show up in your mailbox that you have to figure out where they came from?

Well you pick them up at the union so you know exactly where they came from. Yeah. Well while I was with the Letterman Show the Dean of Music at North Texas State came up to New York and took me out to lunch. And they needed somebody to be the director of the 1:00 Lab Band. You know so I asked him how much it paid and he told me how much it paid and I was making more than three times that much at the Letterman Show. So because I was playing seven instruments on a daily basis and arranging, so you know I had to…
You need a roadie. Have you ever turned down any work either because financially it didn’t work for you or it just was out of your realm of feeling you could do a good job with it?
